title: O'lchamda adashmaslik usuli
caption: 📏 O'lchamda adashmaslikning ishonchli usuli Chetdan kiyim-poyabzal qaytarish qimmat. Shuning uchun «odatda 42 kiyaman» degan taxmin emas, santimetr bilan ishlang. 👟 Poyabzal 1. Qog'ozga turing, tovon va eng uzun barmoq uchini belgilang 2. Oraliqni santimetrda o'lchang — bu oyoq uzunligi 3. Do'konning o'z jadvalidan sm ustunini toping, 0,5–1 sm zaxira qo'shing 👕 Kiyim • O'zingizga yaxshi tushgan kiyimni tekis yoyib, ko'krak kengligi va uzunligini o'lchang • Do'kon jadvalidagi tovar o'lchamlari bilan solishtiring ⚠️ Xitoy do'konlarida o'lchamlar ko'pincha 1–2 pog'ona kichik bo'ladi — harfga (M, L) emas, santimetrga qarang. 📊 Taxminiy moslik (erkaklar poyabzali): 26 sm ≈ EU 41 ≈ US 8 · 27 sm ≈ EU 42 ≈ US 9 · 28 sm ≈ EU 43–44 ≈ US 10. Brendga qarab farq qiladi. 📲 O'lcham qo'llanmalari — ilovada ➖➖➖ @Pochtam_shopo #olcham
prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 cover image for a Telegram channel post. Clean, modern 3D-minimal style, calm and trustworthy. Pure white background with one large soft lavender (#EEEEFC) rounded shape behind the upper half.

1) Top-left: a small solid indigo (#4F46E5) rounded pill with white bold text "#olcham".
2) Center: a bare foot outline drawn on a white sheet of paper with a yellow-and-indigo measuring tape along it, a pencil, and a neat sneaker beside it. Render it as a soft 3D clay illustration with matte surfaces in white and indigo (#4F46E5) with small touches of warm yellow (#F59E0B); soft studio lighting, gentle shadows, generous space around it.
3) Below the illustration: a large bold near-black (#11111B) headline, at most two lines: "O'lchamda adashmang"
4) Under the headline, a smaller medium-grey line: "Santimetr bilan o'lchang"
5) Bottom, above a thin light divider: left bold near-black "@Pochtam_shopo".

One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.
notes: Moslik jadvali taxminiy — postda shunday deb yozilgan.
